## Why This Is Asked
Tests basic observability, safe auto-remediation, and IAM trust for SAP on EC2. 

## Key Concepts
- CloudWatch Logs integration for SAP trace data
- VPC Flow Logs for network visibility
- CloudWatch alarms + Lambda auto-remediation
- Safe-guards to avoid restart loops
- IAM role permissions for logs and EC2 commands

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SAPRemediationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: '/'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SAPRemediation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                Resource: '*'
  SAPRemediationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt SAPRemediationRole.Arn
      Runtime: nodejs14.x
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          exports.handler = async () => { console.log('Restart SAP HANA if needed'); };
  SAPHANA_CPU_Alarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: SAPHANA_CPU_Alarm
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref SAPInstance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !GetAtt SAPRemediationFunction.Arn
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical automation skills for SAP HANA backup reliability, emphasizing serverless event-driven verification, durable state management, and timely alerting mechanisms.

## Key Concepts
- S3 versioning with encrypted backup storage
- Lambda event-driven processing on S3 PUT operations
- Backup integrity verification using cryptographic checksums
- Durable result storage via DynamoDB
- Automated alerting through SNS or CloudWatch

## Code Example
```javascript
// Pseudocode: verify backup integrity
function verifyBackup(backupKey) {
  const actual = computeChecksum(backupData);
  const expected = getExpectedChecksum(backupKey);
  
  const result = {
    backupKey,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: actual === expected ? 'verified' : 'failed',
    actualChecksum: actual,
    expectedChecksum: expected
  };
  
  // Record in DynamoDB for durability
  dynamoDB.put(result);
  
  // Alert on failures
  if (result.status === 'failed') {
    sns.publish({
      message: `Backup integrity check failed for ${backupKey}`,
      subject: 'SAP HANA Backup Alert'
    });
  }
  
  return result;
}
```

## CloudFormation Example
```yaml
Resources:
  BackupVerificationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: SAP-HANA-BackupVerificationRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::your-backup-bucket
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/backup-verification-results
        - PolicyName: SNSAccessPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: arn:aws:sns:*:*:backup-alerts
```

- Key rotation and auditing via CloudTrail and AWS Config

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  SAPCentralCMK:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Central CMK for SAP HANA Backup Encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      MultiRegion: false
      PendingWindowInDays: 30

  SAPCentralCMKPolicy:
    Type: AWS::KMS::KeyPolicy
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref SAPCentralCMK
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: sap-cmk-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow Business Unit Accounts Usage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub arn:aws:iam::BU_ACCOUNT_1:root
                - !Sub arn:aws:iam::BU_ACCOUNT_2:root
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: Allow CloudTrail Logging
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
```
